title: v1_129 / Chat
content:
## Chat

### Run commands with `!` prefix

You can now prefix chat messages with a `!` to run their contents as terminal commands. This works in [agent host](#the-agent-host) sessions both in the editor and Agents window.

![Screenshot showing running a terminal command from chat with the ! prefix.](images/1_129/bang-commands.webp)

### BYOK models with the Copilot agent harness

You can now use [Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) models](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/agent-customization/language-models#_bring-your-own-language-model-key) in the Agents window when you select the **Copilot** harness running on [the agent host](#the-agent-host).

<video src="images/1_129/byok-agents-window.mp4" title="Video showing a BYOK model used with the Copilot agent harness in the Agents window." autoplay loop controls muted></video>



### Migrate prompt files to skills (Experimental)

Prompt files (`*.prompt.md`) are used to describe custom slash commands. They are only supported in the Local agent harness while other harnesses express slash commands with skills. For compatibility across harnesses, we recommend to migrate all prompt files to skills.

With `setting(chat.customizations.promptMigration.enabled)` enabled, if you select a harness running on the [the agent host](#the-agent-host) and you have migratable prompt files, you'll now see a 'Migrate Prompts' entry in the AI Customizations overview.

The migration interface lets you:

* View prompt files from both workspace (`.github/prompts/`) and user data locations.
* Migrate selected files to skills and open the newly created skills.

![migrate prompt files](./images/1_129/migrate-prompt-files.webp)
